title: Atlas kickoff and success measures
content: We are starting the developer platform initiative. Please help define adoption and onboarding measures for the first release.

title: Re: Atlas kickoff and success measures
content: I will map the identity and integration work and bring an initial plan to the architecture session.

title: Platform architecture options
content: I compared a shared control plane with a service-owned model. The shared control plane is simpler for onboarding, but we need clear service boundaries.

title: Re: Platform architecture options
content: Agreed. I will document the Graph and identity integration boundary and call out the token ownership decision.

title: Service catalog API draft
content: The first API draft covers ownership, lifecycle state, repository links, and support contacts. Could you review the event contract before we lock it?

title: Re: Service catalog API draft
content: I have added the integration examples and error model. The remaining decision is whether lifecycle events are emitted synchronously or through the queue.

title: CI runner capacity risk
content: The shared runner pool is close to capacity during parallel builds. I recommend adding autoscaling before the pilot teams migrate.

title: Re: CI runner capacity risk
content: Please size the autoscaling option and estimate the effect on the pilot timeline. We will review the recommendation this week.

title: Test strategy for the platform pilot
content: The API contract tests are ready, but we need a decision on whether the first pilot requires full browser coverage or a smaller smoke suite.

title: Re: Test strategy for the platform pilot
content: Start with the smoke suite for the pilot and track browser coverage as a release criterion. I will record that in the decision log.

title: Threat model needs an owner
content: The first threat model review found an open question about how service credentials are rotated. Can you confirm who owns the implementation?

title: Re: Threat model needs an owner
content: I will coordinate the application integration piece. Grady owns the platform secret rotation; let's capture both responsibilities in the security actions.

title: Developer portal onboarding flow
content: The prototype is ready for a short usability review. Please check whether the ownership and escalation steps are clear to a new service team.

title: Re: Developer portal onboarding flow
content: The flow is clear overall. I noticed the API credential step needs a link to the sandbox guidance; I will send the wording today.

title: Sprint 6 dependency check
content: The staging tenant is still waiting on the network rule change. Can you confirm whether integration testing can start without it?

title: Re: Sprint 6 dependency check
content: The API contract tests can start, but end-to-end validation cannot. Please keep the network rule as a blocker for the next delivery review.

title: Service metadata import results
content: The first metadata import found duplicate ownership entries in 12 repositories. I have attached the report and proposed a deterministic merge rule.

title: Re: Service metadata import results
content: Use the repository team as the source of truth and flag conflicting entries for review. Please include a count of unresolved conflicts in the next report.

title: Pilot adoption feedback
content: Three pilot teams completed onboarding. The main friction point is unclear ownership of the first production deployment.

title: Re: Pilot adoption feedback
content: Could you separate onboarding friction from deployment approval in the findings? I will raise the approval owner at the next steering meeting.

title: Release gate checklist
content: The release checklist is missing the rollback rehearsal and the service owner acknowledgement. Both need named owners before the pilot expands.

title: Re: Release gate checklist
content: I will confirm the service-owner acknowledgement with the pilot teams. Please add the rollback rehearsal as a release gate and keep it open until evidence is attached.

title: Decision required: pilot expansion
content: The steering group needs a recommendation on expanding from three pilot teams to eight. Please include the unresolved security and runner-capacity risks.

title: Re: Decision required: pilot expansion
content: I will prepare the recommendation with explicit go/no-go criteria and outstanding owners for security approval and runner capacity.

title: Runbook review requested
content: The operator runbook is ready for review. Could you confirm the incident escalation path and the contact for Graph integration failures?

title: Re: Runbook review requested
content: The escalation path is correct. Please add the sandbox tenant owner and the MCP service contact to the Graph integration section.

title: API versioning question
content: The service catalog endpoint is ready for pilot use. Should we keep the preview field names for one release or rename them before consumers integrate?

title: Re: API versioning question
content: Keep the preview names for this pilot and document the compatibility window. Please open a decision record so consumers know the planned rename date.

title: Pilot feedback synthesis
content: Users understand the service catalog, but several asked for a clearer way to see who approves production access. I recommend adding the approval owner to the service card.

title: Re: Pilot feedback synthesis
content: That is a useful improvement. Please validate the wording with two pilot teams and bring a short recommendation to Friday's review.

title: Production observability gate
content: The dashboards are live, but the alert thresholds still need service-owner sign-off. Can you confirm whether the pilot expansion waits for that approval?

title: Re: Production observability gate
content: Yes, keep expansion blocked until the service owners acknowledge the thresholds. Please include the acknowledgement status in tomorrow's release review.

title: Initial outcome measures
content: I drafted adoption, deployment lead time, and first-week support load as the pilot measures. Please check whether service ownership clarity should be a separate measure.

title: Re: Initial outcome measures
content: Yes, track ownership clarity separately. We should distinguish a completed catalog entry from a team that has completed a deployment.

title: Identity boundary decision record
content: The decision record is ready. It keeps user delegated access for mailbox reads and isolates the provisioning workload from user tokens. Could you validate the consent wording before I publish it?

title: Re: Identity boundary decision record
content: The separation looks right. Please add that the seed credential is temporary and must be removed after sandbox setup.

title: API contract review comments
content: I added the owner contact and lifecycle state to the catalog schema. The queue event still needs a stable idempotency key. Can you confirm the Graph adapter can pass the event ID through?

title: Re: API contract review comments
content: It can pass the event ID unchanged. Please keep retries at least once and document that consumers must deduplicate by ID.

title: Runner quota request update
content: Azure has approved the quota increase in the test subscription. I will apply the scaling policy after the load test; please keep the production runner configuration out of this change.

title: Re: Runner quota request update
content: Thanks. Keep the change limited to the test subscription and send me the post-load-test queue times before we mark the capacity risk resolved.

title: Smoke suite results for pilot
content: The API smoke suite passed in staging. Browser coverage remains out of scope for the first pilot, but the release checklist currently treats it as mandatory. Can you confirm the exception?

title: Re: Smoke suite results for pilot
content: Use the API smoke suite as the pilot gate and record browser coverage as a follow-up, with a named owner after the pilot review.

title: Threat model review actions
content: The review found that refresh-token handling is not covered in the current diagram. Please add the session expiry path and confirm whether any long-lived credential is stored by the integration service.

title: Re: Threat model review actions
content: I will add the expiry path today. The service uses managed identity in Azure; the local seed secret is only for the temporary test setup and will be removed after import.

title: Portal onboarding prototype ready
content: The onboarding flow now shows the service owner, repository, and support route. I am not sure whether the production approver belongs on the first screen or only at deployment time. Could you get pilot feedback?

title: Re: Portal onboarding prototype ready
content: I will ask the pilot teams during Monday's review. Keep the approver field behind the deployment step until we hear from them.

title: Staging network change window
content: The network team can apply the staging rule Wednesday at 16:00. The end-to-end test slot is booked for Thursday morning. Please confirm the service is ready before I release the slot.

title: Re: Staging network change window
content: The adapter is ready for contract tests. Please keep Thursday as tentative until Grady confirms the rule has propagated; we should avoid testing against a partially updated route.

title: Metadata import exception list
content: I reduced the conflict set from twelve repositories to three. Two have an inactive team alias and one has a different owner in the repository file. Can you confirm the escalation contact for the remaining three?

title: Re: Metadata import exception list
content: Send the three conflicts to their service owners and copy Adele if there is no response by Tuesday. Do not overwrite the catalog values until they confirm.

title: How should we count partial onboarding?
content: Two pilot teams registered services but have not completed a deployment. The draft dashboard counts them as onboarded. Should I split registration from end-to-end onboarding in the report?

title: Re: How should we count partial onboarding?
content: Yes, show registration and first successful deployment separately. Please update the chart before Friday and keep the three-team target unchanged.

title: Rollback rehearsal evidence needed
content: The rehearsal finished, but the release record links to the planning document instead of the run log. Please send the evidence URL before I close the rollback gate.

title: Re: Rollback rehearsal evidence needed
content: I found the run log in the staging folder and sent the correct link to the release record. Please keep the owner acknowledgement gate open separately.

title: Steering decision pack due today
content: I need the final security sign-off and updated runner margin before noon. If either is missing, the recommendation should remain no-go for the eight-team expansion.

title: Re: Steering decision pack due today
content: Security has not signed off the expiry policy yet. The runner estimate is in, but I would keep the recommendation conditional and list both open owners.

title: Runbook publication checklist
content: The Graph failure escalation and sandbox contacts are included. The runbook still has the old incident channel name. Can you confirm the new channel before I publish?

title: Re: Runbook publication checklist
content: Use #platform-operations. Please publish after the link check and send the final URL to Pradeep so he can confirm the on-call section.

title: Preview field rename timeline
content: Two pilot consumers are already using the preview names. I recommend keeping them until the expansion decision and providing a compatibility date. Could you review the migration note?

title: Re: Preview field rename timeline
content: The note is clear. Please tie the rename to a published date rather than expansion approval, and ask the consumers for a migration estimate by next Wednesday.

title: Approval owner label: final pilot feedback
content: Both pilot teams preferred 'Production approver' to 'Approval owner'. I will send the final wording and screenshot tomorrow. Can you add it to the release review agenda?

title: Re: Approval owner label: final pilot feedback
content: I have added it to Friday's agenda. Please send the screenshot by 15:00 tomorrow so Lynne can include it in the release pack.

title: Owner acknowledgements still missing
content: I checked with the pilot teams. Two service owners have acknowledged the alert thresholds, but the third has not replied. Can you confirm whether the expansion gate should remain blocked?

title: Re: Owner acknowledgements still missing
content: Keep it blocked until the third acknowledgement is recorded. Please add the missing owner and due date to tomorrow's review notes.

title: Architecture review: deployment boundary
content: The ADR now separates catalog control-plane APIs from deployment execution. I left the event schema open because Diego's contract still uses a mutable service name. Please review before the design forum.

title: Re: Architecture review: deployment boundary
content: I agree the service name should not be the event key. Use an immutable service ID and keep the display name as a mutable field. I will leave a comment on the ADR.

title: Retry and idempotency contract
content: I added an idempotency example and dead-letter behavior to the API contract. Could you check whether the MCP adapter should surface the original event ID in its error response?

title: Re: Retry and idempotency contract
content: Expose the event ID in structured diagnostics, but do not include the full payload or credentials. I will review the error mapping in the adapter.

title: Load test completed: runner pool
content: The quota increase is active and queue time fell from eleven minutes to four at the planned concurrency. The autoscaling policy still needs a cost ceiling before we enable it for the pilot.

title: Re: Load test completed: runner pool
content: Good result. Please add a maximum instance count and alert threshold, then keep autoscaling disabled until Megan approves the revised monthly estimate.

title: Regression test ownership
content: The smoke tests are green. I have not found an owner for the three browser regressions reported by the pilot teams. Should these block the pilot or go into the post-pilot backlog?

title: Re: Regression test ownership
content: They should not block the limited pilot, but each needs a ticket and an owner. Please ask Johanna to triage the screenshots and include the accepted risk in the test summary.

title: Credential expiry control evidence
content: The updated threat model is ready. I still need evidence that the managed identity is restricted to the test resource group and that the temporary seed credential has an expiry date.

title: Re: Credential expiry control evidence
content: The identity is scoped to the test resource group. I will attach the secret expiry screenshot to the security record after the seed exercise; please keep the control open until the evidence is attached.

title: Usability test: approval step
content: Five users completed the onboarding test. Four expected the approver field before deployment and one expected it on the service card. Could you choose the wording for the follow-up round?

title: Re: Usability test: approval step
content: Put the approver on the service card and repeat the deployment step in the flow. Please validate the shorter label with Patti before the next test session.

title: Milestone update: staging integration
content: The network rule is live and contract tests have passed. End-to-end validation is now scheduled for Thursday. The deployment window is still dependent on the smoke suite result.

title: Re: Milestone update: staging integration
content: Thanks. Keep the deployment window provisional until Henrietta posts the smoke result. If it slips, please update the pilot teams before the daily stand-up.

title: Owner reconciliation completed
content: All three repository owners confirmed the corrected metadata. I have not imported the changes yet because the catalog snapshot is from Monday. Can you confirm whether I should refresh it first?

title: Re: Owner reconciliation completed
content: Refresh the snapshot before import and retain the previous values in the audit file. Please report the number of changed records after the run.

title: Pilot dashboard definition
content: I separated service registration from successful first deployment. The trend now shows two completed deployments and one team waiting on an approver. Please confirm the labels before I circulate the dashboard.

title: Re: Pilot dashboard definition
content: The labels are clear. Please include the waiting team's approval dependency in the steering summary and avoid calling it a failed onboarding.

title: Release pack: evidence still outstanding
content: The rollback evidence is attached now. I have the smoke results and owner list, but the service owner acknowledgement for the alert thresholds is still missing from one pilot team.

title: Re: Release pack: evidence still outstanding
content: Keep the release gate open for that team and name the owner in the pack. The rollback evidence closes only the rollback item; it does not replace the acknowledgement.

title: Runner cost ceiling for expansion
content: Grady's estimate is within the revised range, but the autoscaling cap is not in the policy yet. I need a confirmed monthly ceiling before I can recommend expanding the pilot.

title: Re: Runner cost ceiling for expansion
content: I have asked Grady to add the cap and provide the projected maximum. Keep the recommendation conditional until that is reviewed with the security sign-off.

title: Operations runbook published
content: The corrected escalation path is live in the runbook. Pradeep has not yet confirmed the on-call contact, so I marked that section as pending review rather than complete.

title: Re: Operations runbook published
content: Thanks for leaving the status explicit. Please send Pradeep the review link and ask for confirmation by Monday; leave the contact section open until then.

title: Consumer migration estimates
content: Two consumers can migrate within a sprint; the third has not replied. I sent the compatibility note and asked them to confirm an owner. Should I keep the date provisional?

title: Re: Consumer migration estimates
content: Yes, mark the date provisional and keep the third consumer as an open dependency. Please include the response deadline in next week's decision review.

title: Second usability round results
content: The revised service card made the approver easier to find for all six participants. One participant still expected to see the escalation contact before requesting access. I will add that recommendation to the summary.

title: Re: Second usability round results
content: Please add the escalation contact as a recommendation and keep the current release scope unchanged. We can decide whether to include it after tomorrow's release review.

title: Runner policy cost ceiling
content: Please send the monthly estimate for the proposed pool cap and include the expected peak usage. We need this before enabling autoscaling for the pilot.

title: Re: Runner policy cost ceiling
content: I have the quota model and will send the capped estimate tomorrow. The current policy remains disabled until you approve the ceiling.

title: Threat model: token expiry path
content: I added the delegated token expiry path. Can you check that the diagram separates the user token from the service identity used by the deployment worker?

title: Re: Threat model: token expiry path
content: The separation is clear now. Please add a note that the local seed credential is temporary and has an explicit removal task after test data import.

title: Service card feedback request
content: I moved the production approver onto the service card. Could you check the label against what the pilot users said and let me know if it reads naturally?

title: Re: Service card feedback request
content: The placement is right. 'Production approver' tested better than 'Approval owner'. I suggest we repeat the question with the second pilot team before locking the copy.

title: Staging window confirmation
content: The deployment slot is reserved for Thursday morning. Please confirm the final smoke run is complete by 16:00 today or I will release the slot to the platform team.

title: Re: Staging window confirmation
content: The smoke suite passed. One end-to-end check is still running against the refreshed catalog cache; I will confirm the slot before 15:00.

title: Snapshot refresh before import
content: The three owner corrections are approved. I can refresh the repository snapshot now; please confirm the event schema is frozen so the mapping does not change mid-import.

title: Re: Snapshot refresh before import
content: The schema is frozen for this pilot. Please preserve the previous owner values in the audit file and send me the import count when it finishes.

title: Alert threshold acknowledgements
content: I have two service owner acknowledgements. Can you confirm which team is missing so we can assign a person to follow up before the steering pack closes?

title: Re: Alert threshold acknowledgements
content: The missing acknowledgement is from the analytics pilot. I have sent the owner a reminder, but there is no response yet. Please keep the gate open.

title: Consumer migration date request
content: Two consumers confirmed their migration window. The analytics integration has not replied. Can you check who owns that API dependency?

title: Re: Consumer migration date request
content: Lidia has the service contact. I will ask her to confirm the owner, but keep the migration date provisional until the consumer responds.

title: Runbook contact verification
content: The updated runbook names the Graph escalation path. Please confirm the on-call contact and rotation link so I can publish the final handover version.

title: Re: Runbook contact verification
content: The rotation link is correct. I am checking with the application team about the Graph support contact and will confirm by tomorrow morning.

title: Decision pack: remaining release conditions
content: The pilot feedback is positive, but the third alert acknowledgement and final runbook contact are still outstanding. Can you confirm we are holding the expansion decision until both are closed?

title: Re: Decision pack: remaining release conditions
content: Yes. Keep the recommendation conditional and list both owners. Positive usability feedback does not close the operational gates.

title: Analytics API contact
content: The analytics team lead is Freja, but I do not know who will own the migration. I have asked them to nominate someone by Tuesday and will update the service record when they do.

title: Re: Analytics API contact
content: Thanks. I will leave the migration owner unassigned until Freja confirms. Please let me know if they respond before the review.

title: Sprint 2 capacity check
content: The board has 18 points of committed work and two people are out Friday. Can you confirm whether to move the onboarding copy task into the next sprint?

title: Re: Sprint 2 capacity check
content: Move the copy task if the API contract slips. Keep the immutable ID decision and sandbox integration as the sprint priorities.

title: Event payload example for review
content: The payload now includes serviceId, lifecycleState, and eventId. Please confirm the consumer can handle an unknown optional field before I merge the schema.

title: Re: Event payload example for review
content: Unknown optional fields are ignored by the current consumer. Add that compatibility rule to the contract and I will approve the example.

title: Keyboard navigation regression
content: The service search loses focus after the results refresh. I recorded the steps and attached a short video. Can you take this or should I assign it to the portal backlog?

title: Re: Keyboard navigation regression
content: I can take it this sprint. I will fix the focus restore and ask Patti to verify the screen-reader announcement before we close the issue.

title: Runner pool alert threshold
content: The queue alert fired twice during the load test, but both cleared before the on-call window. Please lower the warning threshold only after we agree the target queue time.

title: Re: Runner pool alert threshold
content: Agreed. I will keep the current alert and add the four-minute queue target to the dashboard. We can tune the warning after the next load run.

title: Repository import baseline
content: The baseline contains 42 services across the three pilot teams. Seven have no support contact and twelve have inconsistent owner aliases. Can you validate the totals before I publish?

title: Re: Repository import baseline
content: The totals match my sample. Please separate missing contacts from conflicting ownership in the chart; they need different follow-up owners.

title: Managed identity scope review
content: The test identity can read the deployment artifacts but cannot change subscription policy. Please confirm the role assignment is limited to the test resource group before we close the review.

title: Re: Managed identity scope review
content: Confirmed. The role assignment is scoped to the resource group and policy changes remain denied. I added the role export to the security evidence folder.

title: Service ownership wording
content: The pilot teams understand 'service owner' but are split on 'production approver'. Can you recommend one label that matches the access request process?

title: Re: Service ownership wording
content: Use 'Production approver' for the person authorizing access and keep 'Service owner' for the team contact. Combining them would hide two different responsibilities.

title: Rollback rehearsal slot
content: The rehearsal is booked for Friday at 09:00. Please confirm the smoke suite is stable and the rollback operator has access to the run log before I lock the release slot.

title: Re: Rollback rehearsal slot
content: The smoke suite is stable. Pradeep still needs to verify the operator access; I will keep the rehearsal slot but mark the evidence check as pending.

title: Preview compatibility plan
content: The preview names can remain through the pilot, with a stable rename date communicated one release ahead. Please check the consumer notice before I send it to the three teams.

title: Re: Preview compatibility plan
content: The notice is clear. Add the migration guide link and ask each consumer to name an owner and estimate by September 14.

title: Operations handover draft
content: The runbook covers alerts, deployment rollback, and Graph failures. I need the current release owner and on-call URL before I publish the handover package.

title: Re: Operations handover draft
content: The release owner is correct. Pradeep is checking the rotation URL; please leave the on-call field marked pending until he confirms it.

title: Pilot wave planning
content: I need a go/no-go date for the next wave so I can reserve onboarding support. The third alert acknowledgement is not in the tracker yet; should I keep the date tentative?

title: Re: Pilot wave planning
content: Keep it tentative. We will not confirm the wave until the acknowledgement and the runbook contact are recorded in the release pack.

title: Security evidence still missing
content: I verified the alert routing and managed identity. The temporary seed credential is still present in the local configuration; please confirm when it is removed so I can close the security finding.

title: Re: Security evidence still missing
content: The removal check is assigned to Nicolai after the import exercise. I will keep the finding open and require a screenshot or secret inventory record before closure.

title: Catalog cache invalidation test
content: The owner update event was accepted but the read endpoint served the previous value for another five minutes. Can you confirm the expected cache expiry before I log this as a defect?

title: Re: Catalog cache invalidation test
content: The event should invalidate immediately. I found a missing consumer subscription and will fix it today; please keep the test open until the retest passes.

title: Pilot baseline review
content: The first survey has 11 responses. Users want a clear support path and an owner they can contact. Can you add those fields to the architecture review checklist?

title: Re: Pilot baseline review
content: I added both fields to the checklist. We still need to decide which are mandatory at service registration versus before production deployment.

title: Next sprint commitment
content: The team can take the runbook handover and API compatibility note, but not both browser coverage and the cost review. Please keep the risk work ahead of optional polish.

title: Re: Next sprint commitment
content: I moved browser coverage to the post-pilot backlog and reserved capacity for the cost review. The handover remains dependent on Pradeep's on-call confirmation.

title: Second pilot session summary
content: All six participants found the approver on the service card. Two asked to see the escalation contact earlier. I will send the final recommendation to Adele by Thursday.

title: Re: Second pilot session summary
content: The wording is consistent with the survey comments. Please include the two requests as a next-increment recommendation and do not change the current release acceptance criteria.
